svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Robot Learning and Human–Robot Interaction: research map
svg.desc: Robots that learn from people and work with them. Sub-problems: Learning from human video (How does a human demo become robot actions?); Reinforcement learning (How to keep policies stable in hybrid action spaces?); Manipulation in clutter (Grasp the target, remove a blocker, or wait?); Natural interaction (Can gestures and speech stay in sync?). Open questions: Generalizing from a few demos to new objects; Knowing when the robot is unsure, and asking; Interaction that adapts to each person.
